text:
Priya Nair: Heads-up: were targeting this Friday 10am PT to publish the Solara customer story (embargo). Need final quote + logo approval + legal sign-off by EOD Thursday.
Ari Gomez: On the blog/post copy. Will swap in the final benchmark stat when Samir posts it. Also planning a short social carousel + email CTA linking to the webinar.
Samir Patel: Updated numbers after the latest Optimize run: ~3.2x median latency improvement and ~60% token cost reduction on their workload. Pasting suggested callouts now.
Ari Gomez: Nice. For hero we should round: "3x latency improvement" and keep cost % as a secondary line.
Priya Nair: Webinar is scheduled for Tue 2pm PT  provisional link pending Ops. Were bundling webinar invite + on-demand in the same nurture email. Maya, can you confirm SFDC campaign and UTM plan?
Maya Tran: Will create SFDC campaign 'solara_casepack_apr2026' and set UTM_campaign=solara_casepack. Also flagging lead routing: inbound registrants -> AE team A queue.
Janelle Wu: Legal note: we need the customer to sign a short approval form for quote + logo usage. Also counsel prefers no direct competitor comparisons; avoid naming other vendors in the copy.
Priya Nair: Got it. Priya -> @Solara_CS pinged their legal/marketing for quote sign-off and logo files. ETA EOD Thurs.
Samir Patel: Draft quote candidates from the interview:
- "Redwood helped us reduce inference cost by ~60% and dramatically improved tail latency."
- "With Redwood, our inference runs faster and costs less, which lets us ship more quickly."
Ari Gomez: I like the second for tone. Short one-line variant: "Redwood made our inference faster and cheaper."
Janelle Wu: Please send the exact transcript snippet used. Also we should slightly soften the latency phrasing per counsel: use "significant latency improvement" instead of an explicit percentile claim.
Priya Nair: Uploaded transcript excerpt: https://drive.redwood/solara/clip-4.txt
Maya Tran: OpsBot reminder: add SFDC campaign and set UTM in the email template. Also pinging Eng for webinar recording permissions.
OpsBot: Reminder queued: add SFDC campaign 'solara_casepack_apr2026' and set UTM_campaign=solara_casepack.
Ari Gomez: Copy draft (working):
> "Solara accelerated their model rollout and cut inference costs using Redwoods inference runtime. Join our webinar to see how."
Short hero: "3x latency improvement; 60% lower inference costs."
Samir Patel: Suggest hero tweak to avoid exact claim: "~3x median latency improvement" but if legal wants rounding, we can go with "3x".
Janelle Wu: Final from counsel: use rounded hero stat "3x" and replace the 95% phrasing in the body with "significant latency improvements in production." Also need signed approval form attached to the publish ticket.
Priya Nair: If Solara signs by EOD Thu, Ari will schedule blog + social + email for Fri 10am PT. If not, we push to Monday.
Ari Gomez: I'll prepare the scheduling slots and social copy drafts regardless. Also prepping a 15-min pre-webinar rehearsal with Solara and Eng.
Maya Tran: Noted. I'll set the SFDC campaign, map UTMs, and create the AE routing rule for registrants.
Samir Patel: Final stat for marketing: "3x latency improvement; ~60% inference cost reduction."
Janelle Wu: I'll follow up with counsel and confirm the final approved language once the customer signs.
Priya Nair: Thanks all. Will update the launch calendar and the publish checklist in Asana. :partyparrot:
